subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as the public global API for controlling workspace bootstrap context, including the `standard` versus `full` hook-extra behavior?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it creates a new user-facing prompt-context default with compatibility and session-state implications that code review cannot decide without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Accept tiered bootstrap API
options.body: Land this shape after adding public docs/config validation coverage and confirming the hook-extra semantics are intentional.

options.title: Narrow or redesign
options.body: Keep the linked proposal open and ask for a smaller API around existing context controls or per-session policy before landing code.

options.title: Decline core config surface
options.body: Close this PR after deciding that token-budget bootstrap control should stay in another existing or future mechanism.

recommendation.title: Accept tiered bootstrap API
recommendation.body: Land this shape after adding public docs/config validation coverage and confirming the hook-extra semantics are intentional.
